Welcome to Alexander Studios!

My name is Alexander and I make Lego stop-motion animations. I try to make high quality brick films at 15 fps, so it may take a while before I publish a new video, but I’m always working on one ;)

By the way, if you like the custom vehicles appearing in my videos make sure to check out my MOC- (my own creation) videos. There’s a great chance you find a stop-motion tutorial of a vehicle you’re interested in.

And of course, if you don’t want to miss my next video, make sure to subscribe!
